assumptions: All graphs and digraphs are finite and simple unless the statement explicitly says otherwise.

definitions.definition: A graph with no induced cycle of length greater than 3.
A family of complete subgraphs whose edge sets are pairwise disjoint and whose union is E(G).
Existence of constants C and n₀ giving the bound n²/6+Cn for all n≥n₀.

domain.description: Finite simple chordal graphs G on n vertices.

quantifiers.domain: a real constant C>0 and an integer n₀≥1
integers n≥n₀ and finite simple chordal graphs G on n vertices
edge partitions P of G into at most n²/6+Cn complete subgraphs

statement.text: Do there exist universal constants C and n₀ such that every chordal graph G on n≥n₀ vertices has an edge partition into at most n²/6 + Cn cliques?

title: Clique partitions of chordal graphs (Erdős Problem 81)
